payload.title: Manager, Project Management
payload.description:
Company Description
McDonald’s is proud to be one of the most recognized brands in the world, with restaurants in over 100 countries that serve 70 million customers daily. As the global leader in the food service industry, our legacy of innovation and hard work continues to drive us.
From drive thru updates to delivery to mobile order and pay, we are innovating quickly and growing. Joining McDonald's means thinking big and preparing for a career that can have influence around the world.
 

Department Overview

Help Shape the Future of Digital Governance

We’re looking for a Manager to help transform digital governance across Global Supply Chain and the broader enterprise, including suppliers and distributors. This role will turn governance principles into practical decision rights, processes, and tools that increase accountability, manage risk, and accelerate responsible digital delivery.

Duties

  • Transform Governance Processes: Manage a program to design, develop, and deploy a practical digital governance framework across Global Supply Chain – global, markets, suppliers, and distributors.
  • Deliver Target Operating Model: Define decision rights, intake and prioritization processes, standards, controls, governance forums, and escalation paths.
  • Drive Adoption and Assurance: Align global functions, markets, and suppliers; lead readiness and adoption; and measure compliance, control effectiveness, digital adoption, and risk reduction.
  • Measure and Improve: Track adoption and performance, identify gaps, and improve governance based on data and stakeholder feedback.

 

Why This Role Matters

This role will help the organization move faster with greater clarity and control by connecting enterprise requirements to Global Supply Chain realities. It also enables our business to be future-ready to adopt and scale AI to drive business value. The result: stronger accountability, lower risk and duplication, greater value from digital investments, and a scalable foundation for growth.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business (Finance, Economics, Accounting), Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years in digital transformation, business process design, project management, change management, or related experience.
  • Proven ability to translate business needs into processes, controls, and requirements to implement a digital solution for the business.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives across markets and business, technology, data, legal, compliance, and control teams.
  • Strong systems thinking, stakeholder influence, communication, change leadership, and execution skills; global travel as needed.

Career Growth & Impact

In this role you will gain:

  • Global Transformation Exposure: Shape solutions across markets and build a broad network spanning supply chain, legal, compliance, operations, data, and technology.
  • Enterprise Impact: Strengthen compliance assurance, operational resilience, and readiness for evolving regulation while simplifying execution.
  • Leadership Development: Deepen capabilities in transformation leadership, process design, digital product delivery, stakeholder influence, and global change management.
  • Distinctive Expertise: Build experience at the intersection of supply chain, regulation, compliance, resilience, business process, data, and digital technology.

Additional Qualifications

Technical Skills:

  • Understanding of digital solutions, data model, and data governance, specifically in a supply chain operating environments as part of a global program or project.
  • Ability to create decision frameworks, process documentation, performance measures, and executive-ready reporting; relevant certifications are a plus.

Leadership & Soft Skills:

  • Trusted relationship builder with strong written, verbal, facilitation, and senior-stakeholder communication skills.
  • Structured, analytical, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.

Other:

  • Willingness to travel globally as needed for governance workshops, partner engagement, and transformation activities.

 

Additional information
At McDonalds we are People from all Walks of Life...


People are at the heart of everything we do, and they make the McDonalds experience. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture that means people can be their best authentic self in our restaurants and offices, which helps us to better serve our customers. We have a strong heritage of diversity and representation within our communities, which we are proud of. The diversity of our people, customers, Franchisees, and suppliers gives us strength.

We do not tolerate inequality, injustice, or discrimination of any kind. These are hugely important issues and a brand with our reach and relevance means we have a very meaningful role to play.

We also recognise our responsibility as a large employer to continue being active in our communities, helping to develop skills and drive aspirations that will help people to be more aware of the world of work and more successful within it, whether with McDonalds or elsewhere.

payload.title: McDonald's Progressive Young Farmer Programme
payload.description:
About Us

McDonalds has run its business in the UK since 1974 and currently operates over 1500 restaurants across the UK and Ireland, serving almost four million customers each day. McDonalds is one of the UKs largest private sector employers, employing over 170,000 people.

Department Overview

McDonald's Progressive Young Farmer Programme

Undergraduate Industry Placement

Placement Duration: 12 Months
Location: UK & Ireland
Salary: £26,500
Programme Dates: August 2027 – August 2028

 

 

What Team Will I Be Part Of?

Participants will join one of McDonald's leading suppliers and gain practical experience across the supply chain, following products from farms through to restaurants.

You will report to a supervisor within the supplier's Agriculture Team while gaining exposure to different areas of the wider supply chain.

Duties

The Opportunity

This placement offers the chance to:

  • Join one of McDonald's key suppliers for a full year.
  • Rotate through multiple areas of McDonald's supply chain, from farm to restaurant.
  • Gain hands-on experience with supplier agriculture teams and progressive farms.
  • Work on projects focused on sustainability, technical efficiency, and agricultural innovation.
  • Visit key suppliers to gain insight into agricultural operations and supply chains.
  • Spend a short period working as a crew member in a McDonald's restaurant.
  • Act as an ambassador for McDonald's and its suppliers at industry events.

Qualifications

What Background Do I Need?

We are looking for passionate, curious, self-motivated, and driven undergraduates who can thrive in a fast-paced environment within the McDonald's supply base.

Students from all degree disciplines and backgrounds are encouraged to apply. An agricultural background is not essential, as diverse perspectives strengthen the industry.

Candidates should have:

  • A passion for food, farming, or supply chains.
  • The ability to work independently and within a team.
  • A willingness to learn about careers within food supply chains and farming.

Benefits

  • Competitive placement salary of £26,500.
  • Professional development and mentoring from industry experts.
  • Exposure to the wider agri-food sector across multiple businesses.
  • Flexibility to tailor the programme to your personal development goals.
  • Excellent networking opportunities within both the placement cohort and a global brand.
  • Insight Days with other McDonald's suppliers throughout the year.

Essential Criteria

Applicants must:

  • Hold a full UK or Irish driving licence.
  • Be willing to relocate and/or travel within the UK and Ireland.
  • Be currently undertaking full-time third-level education.
  • Have the legal right to work in the UK and Ireland.

Application Process

1. CV & Cover Letter Submission

  • Applications close at midnight on Monday, 16 November 2026.

2. Video Submission

  • Selected candidates will be invited to submit a video after CV and cover letter review.

3. Assessment Centre

  • Assessment Centre scheduled for Monday, 14 December 2026 in London.

Company Vision and Culture

Our Global vision is to build a better McDonalds and in the UK and Ireland we are working hard to be the UK & Irelands best-loved restaurant company.

McDonalds is defined by its culture. Our culture shapes and informs everything we think and everything we do. Our culture influences the way we interact with each other, and how we interact with customers, franchisees and suppliers. Our culture motivates and inspires us to attract and retain great talent, creating positive, energising, exceptional working environment for us all.

Our values drive our culture and shape our beliefs, our priorities and our actions. They influence the decisions we make, how we treat one another and how we show up as a brand to the world.

 

Serve: We put our customers and our people first

Inclusion: We open our doors to everyone

Integrity: We do the right thing

Community: We are good neighbours

Family: We get better together

 

At McDonalds we are People from all Walks of Life...

People are at the heart of everything we do, and they make the McDonalds experience. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture that means people can be their best authentic self in our restaurants and offices, which helps us to better serve our customers. We have a strong heritage of diversity and representation within our communities, which we are proud of. The diversity of our people, customers, Franchisees and suppliers gives us strength.

We do not tolerate inequality, injustice or discrimination of any kind. These are hugely important issues and a brand with our reach and relevance means we have a very meaningful role to play.

We also recognise our responsibility as a large employer to continue being active in our communities, helping to develop skills and drive aspirations that will help people to be more aware of the world of work and more successful within it, whether with McDonalds or elsewhere.

payload.title: Specialist, Real Estate
payload.description:
Rejoindre McDonald’s, c’est bien plus qu’intégrer une enseigne de restauration rapide : c’est embarquer dans une aventure humaine, innovante et engagée. Avec plus de 1600 restaurants en France et 2 millions de repas servis chaque jour, McDonald’s est un acteur majeur du secteur, porté par des valeurs fortes : service, inclusion, intégrité, communauté et famille.

Nous croyons au potentiel de chacun(e) et mettons un point d’honneur à former, accompagner et faire évoluer nos collaborateurs(trices) tout au long de leur parcours. Derrière chaque restaurant, il y a des équipes passionnées, des carrières qui se construisent, et un engagement sociétal concret — notamment à travers la Fondation Ronald McDonald et nos actions en faveur du sport et de la jeunesse.

Chez McDonald’s, l’énergie collective est notre moteur. Que ce soit dans nos restaurants ou au siège, nos collaborateurs(trices) partagent une même ambition : faire rayonner les Arches dorées et créer chaque jour des moments qui font du bien.

Aperçu du département

Accompagner le projet global de déménagement du siège social de l'entreprise, du cadrage à la mise en service du nouveau site, en garantissant délais, budget, qualité et continuité d’activité. Assurer la coordination de l’ensemble des parties prenantes : équipes internes, prestataires (agence immobilière, architectes, maîtres d’œuvre…), bailleur et gestionnaires techniques.

Tâches

Les responsabilités sont les suivantes :

  • Prise de besoins et conception spatiale

Ateliers ambassadeurs et interviews des directions pour cerner les attentes
Macro-zoning : répartir des services sur les plateaux
Micro-zoning : affecter des collaborateurs dans les zones dédiées
Valider le concept architectural, décoratif et signalétique
Choisir les aménagements : bureaux, salles de réunion, espaces collaboratifs, zones informelles…

  • Coordination technique et opérationnelle

Piloter les prestataires : Real Estate Manager, Architectes, Bureaux d’études, déménageurs …
Organiser les Copils hebdomadaires : suivi du projet, arbitrages, validation des étapes
Coordonner les parties prenantes internes : IT, RH, Services Généraux, Juridique…
Planifier les phases de transfert : mobilier, équipements, archives, IT…
Garantir la continuité d’activité pendant la transition 

  • Communication et conduite du changement

Communication interne et externe : présentations au personnel, CSE, ateliers ambassadeurs
Aider à la mise en place RH de compensations collaborateurs
Mettre en place des outils de communication et de formation
Recueillir les retours collaborateurs et ajustement des dispositifs

  • Budget et prestataires

Élaborer et suivre le budget global du projet et du déménagement : pilotage budgétaire et négociations
Sourcer les prestataires externes si nécessaire (via appel d’offres): restauration collective (RIE), salle de sport, services annexes (gardiennage, sécurité, accueil, courrier…)
Résilier les contrats de prestations liés à l’ancien site

  • Travaux et logistique

Superviser les travaux d’aménagement et de décoration (en support du cabinet référencé) selon les contraintes techniques définies
Levée des réserves successives
État des lieux d’entrée

  • Déménagement et installation

Coordonner le déménagement physique (dont informatique)
Livrer et installer le mobilier
Gérer le SAV et les ajustements post-installation 

Qualifications

Formation supérieure (Bac+4/5) en gestion de projet, logistique, immobilier ou équivalent

Expérience confirmée en gestion de projets complexes, idéalement liés à des déménagements ou à l’aménagement de sites

Excellentes compétences en organisation, coordination et communication

Maîtrise d’outils de gestion de projet

Sens du service, diplomatie, réactivité et capacité à travailler sous pression

Chez McDonald’s, nous mettons tout en œuvre pour offrir à nos collaborateurs(trices) un cadre de travail stimulant, inclusif et bienveillant. Au siège, vous profitez d’un environnement pensé pour le bien-être et la performance : un restaurant d’entreprise, des espaces de détente (babyfoot, billard, ping-pong, pétanque), une salle de sport, ainsi qu’un parking dédié avec bornes pour véhicules électriques.

Nous encourageons l’équilibre vie professionnelle/vie personnelle grâce à une politique de télétravail flexible (2 jours/semaine en moyenne) et la culture du développement en proposant un accès à la formation continue via notre plateforme de formation digitale qui recense plus de 22 000 cours animés par des experts.

Côté avantages :

  • Des réductions dans nos restaurants McDonald’s en France
  • Une participation de l’Employeur à 70% de la mutuelle d’entreprise
  • Une prise en charge de l’abonnement du Pass Navigo à hauteur de 90%
  • Un accès à une salle de sport située dans nos locaux
  • Une épargne salariale attractive
  • Un bonus annuel basé sur la performance individuelle et collective
  • Des opportunités d’évolution au sein du Groupe

Enfin, nous sommes fiers de garantir l’égalité des chances et de promouvoir la diversité au sein de nos équipes, dans un environnement où chacun peut s’épanouir et créer des moments positifs au quotidien.
